title: Zion Lodge burned in 1966 and was rebuilt in 108 days #Shorts
description:
A hundred and eight days. On January twenty-sixth, nineteen sixty-six, the main building of Zion Lodge burned. A prefabricated replacement was up and operating a hundred and eight days later. And all of it stands on the bed of an ancient lake.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 2: The Day the Mountain Fell: Zion's Lost Lake): https://youtu.be/1KUANk1uGtU

#Shorts #Zion #ZionLodge #History #NationalParks
